An apprentice sees something that they feel is a major H&S hazard, they should:
 Let someone else report by phone, when they notice it.
 Report this verbally to their supervisor immediately.
 Leave the cleaner a note so they can sort when they come into the workshop.
 Carry on working in order to get the customers job done, as it’s not their problem.

 a) negative castor

 2. After rectifying an engine fault you need to road test the customer's vehicle. Before you start the
 test it is essential that you:
 a) check the vehicle's tyre pressures, oil level and windscreen washer fluid
 b) complete the job card with all details concerning the vehicle repair
 c) ensure your work bay is tidy and all tools have been put away
 d) check that you hold the correct driver's license for the vehicle
